message.content:
**Texas Traffic Laws – Quick Reference** | Topic | Key Points (Texas Transportation Code) | Practical Tips | |-------|----------------------------------------|----------------| | **Speed Limits** | • 55 mph on rural interstates
• 65 mph on urban interstates
• 45 mph on rural highways (unless posted otherwise)
• 35 mph on urban highways (unless posted otherwise) | • Always obey posted signs; speed limits can change at intersections or construction zones. | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑seat Requirements** | • All drivers and front‑seat passengers must wear seat belts (Sec. 545.001).
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster (Sec. 545.002). | • Check the seat‑belt sign on your vehicle; it’s a legal requirement. | | **DUI / Alcohol** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % is illegal for drivers over 21 (Sec. 545.021).
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (BAC ≥ 0.02 % is illegal).
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | • If you’re ever in doubt, use a ride‑share or public transport. | | **Texting & Phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited (Sec. 545.021).
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | • Use “Do Not Disturb” mode or a hands‑free mount. | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • At uncontrolled intersections, the driver on the right has the right of way (Sec. 545.021).
• Stop signs and traffic signals must be obeyed. | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks. | | **School Bus** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus is loading/unloading children (Sec. 545.021). | • Do not pass a stopped school bus until the stop sign is removed. | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Must signal and check blind spots (Sec. 545.021). | • Avoid cutting off other drivers; maintain safe distance. | | **Parking** | • No parking on sidewalks, crosswalks, or in front of driveways (Sec. 545.021). | • Pay attention to “No Parking” signs and meter times. | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Vehicles must be registered and display a valid license plate (Sec. 545.021).
• Annual safety inspection required for most vehicles (Sec. 545.021). | • Keep registration and inspection stickers up to date. | | **Emergency Vehicles** | • Drivers must yield to emergency vehicles with flashing lights or sirens (Sec. 545.021). | • Pull over to the right side of the road and stop. | | **Driving Under Influence of Drugs** | • Prescription or recreational drugs that impair driving are illegal (Sec. 545.021). | • If you’re under medication that affects driving, consult your doctor. | --- ### How to Stay Informed 1. **Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT)** – Official website: [https://www.txdot.gov](https://www.txdot.gov) *Provides up‑to‑date traffic regulations, road conditions, and safety campaigns.* 2. **Texas Transportation Code** – Available online: [https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/](https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/) *Full legal text for all traffic statutes.* 3. **Local County Courts** – For specific local ordinances (e.g., city speed limits, parking rules). *Check your county’s official website.* 4. **Texas Driver Handbook** – Published by TxDOT, includes all driving rules, penalties, and safety tips. *Downloadable PDF: [https://www.txdot.gov/driverhandbook](https://www.txdot.gov/driverhandbook)* --- ### Quick Legal Reminder - **Seat belts**: Mandatory for all occupants. - **Speed limits**: Always follow posted signs. - **Alcohol**: BAC ≥ 0.08 % is illegal for adults; zero tolerance for under‑21 drivers. - **Phone use**: Hand‑held devices are prohibited while driving. Violations can result in fines, points on your license, and even jail time. If you’re ever unsure, err on the side of caution—use a hands‑free device, keep your speed within limits, and always wear your seat belt. Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law, recent changes, or how to handle a traffic ticket in Texas!
